reviews.title: Was good but then all my data was changed
reviews.text: It used to be good for many years well, I just opened up the app and every record was changed to January 1, 1900 probably a bad update. But that does me no good i lost every record i had for the last few years

reviews.title: Worked until the last update
reviews.text:
I’ve had the app for several years and I liked it. 

Unfortunately, with the last update, it lost all the dates that service was performed on my vehicle. Everything now says January 1, 1900. Disappointed to lose this information.

reviews.text: After an update, all the dates are gone. This makes the app virtually worthless now.

reviews.title: Dates disappear

reviews.title: Do not upgrade to the newest version of VMT.
reviews.text:
The newest update changed all of my entries for the past four years to January one.

Now none of my entries are set up by date, and I can’t tell when I had worked done on the vehicle.

reviews.title: Move it, lose it
reviews.text: Transferred to a new iPhone. Lost all dates of service. Version will not allow custom maintenance entries. Must use table. Table lacking categories. Wow, such a decline in my satisfaction after years of using this app.

reviews.title: All dates reset to Jan 1900
reviews.text: This app seemed to be exactly what I was looking for to keep track of the 5 vehicles we own so I gave it a try.   After a month and half with several detailed entries, all the dates reset to Jan 1 , 1900.   That’s a real drag because I set maintenance schedules for the future based off of various dates so now I have to dig up my receipts again to redo the dates…..or I may just try a different app and hope it’s more reliable.

reviews.title: App was working great
reviews.text: App was working great until it wasn’t. All my service dates are now showing 01-01-0001. App crashes whenever I try to view receipts and the app just crashes. Very disappointing and annoying.

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: I used and appreciated this app but when the app deleted the dates of ALL previous service records I quit using it.  I would gladly upgrade to Pro but am afraid the same thing would happen.

reviews.title: Can’t trust the app
reviews.text: Dates all cleared out randomly after years of tracking and developer is telling people “they should have read the fine print” Lots of free competitor apps. I’ll be switching

reviews.title: I loved the app but it lost all service records.
reviews.text: I have used this app for quite sometime but the latest update wiped out all the dates of all service records in all vehicles. So disappointing

reviews.title: Dates
reviews.text: This app was great until the developer errored on an update causing all users to lose dates of events.

reviews.title: Once good now terrible
reviews.text: The app lost all my Vehicle update dates according to the app every oil change bearing replacement, etc. happened in January 1 in year the year 0001. Makes it really difficult to know the last time I performed certain maintenance. In addition every time I open the app it says my garage is empty and takes two or three minutes to find all my vehicles and equipment.

reviews.title: Erased my dates
reviews.text: Used it for a long while. Recently all my dates are changed to 1-1-1900 so all that work is lost.

reviews.title: All dates erased
reviews.text: Lost all service dates with an update and have not been able to recover them. Moving on to a new app.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Having just lost all my date data with no hope of getting it back a rubbish app no point to it its only job is to store data and it fails to do that

reviews.title: Good basic maintenance tracker, but BEWARE!
reviews.text: I have used VMT on my IPad for over 4 years. I have 2 cars and 2 standby generators that I maintain and this has been a good way to kept record of it. However, I opened the App the other day and while my records were there including my text inputted service notes, ALL THE DATES had defaulted to 1900 and all the mileage and hour records were gone. Really a problem! If you use this app, include dates and mileage in the service notes for backup.

reviews.title: Service dates gone
reviews.text: I recently noticed the new update which looks nice but noticed all the service dates are gone. This is very inconvenient but good thing that the mileage is on there but now I don’t know the last date of when they were service good thing I end up putting dates on like oil filters and things like that. Not a good move. Can this be archived?

reviews.title: Service dates
reviews.text: Been using this app for many years and have five vehicles in the garage, then it must of been after an app update it changed all my service date entries to 01-01-1900. I would have given it five stars but since this issue I gave it only two

reviews.title: Please tell me there is a way to retrieve dates…
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for probably 10+ years for 10-15 different vehicles, mowers, tillers, boats, etc. Now all service dates are gone. Mileage is available for equipment with an odometer, but many don’t have one…or an hour meter. Please let us know if anyway to recover dates.

reviews.title: Service history dates gone!
reviews.text: As others have mentioned, the latest update set all service dates to 01/01/0001

reviews.title: Good until Not good
reviews.text: I have been using this app and maintaining multiple cars for up to three years all of a sudden this summer all dates of maintenance service changed to January 1, 1900 so I’ve lost all my intervals.

reviews.title: Lost 5 years worth of data and receipts.
reviews.text: Very basic app that I found useful for a few years. One day, I opened the app, and all of my data was gone., Including all of my receipts that I had scanned in

reviews.title: It’s good if you pay
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a free solution, go elsewhere. App is completely unreliable for storage of information if you are using the unpaid version.

reviews.title: Service dates gone
reviews.text: All service dates changed to 1-1-1900

reviews.title: Broken update
reviews.text: App was great, even was considering upgrading to pro for the extra features. Then an update wiped out all service dates. Developer’s website is a Facebook group, where they paused all comment, and no updates or apologies have been provided. Find another app.

reviews.title: Dates are gone
reviews.text: I’ve enjoyed a simple method to keep all my car data in one place. Recently all my dates reset to Jan 1 0001.  Luckily I exported my data a year ago but the app is useless with inconsistent or inaccurate dates. I’ll move to Excel going forward.

reviews.title: Log Reset
reviews.text: I have had this app for several years tracking the maintenance on my vehicles. I enjoyed it up to this point, but all of my logs have defaulted to 01–01–1900. Unfortunately, all the data is unusable now I have no idea when maintenance was performed. Great app idea unfortunate event.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I have used the app for years and it’s been great.  I too lost all the service dates for all my records.  What a huge failure that is, will be switching apps now.

reviews.title: Dates are Gone
reviews.text: App was working great but suddenly all service records dates changed to 01.01.1900.  Needs a fix this.

reviews.title: Data loss. Value is gone
reviews.text: It was nice tracking the maintenance on my cars in 1 app.  Now I wish I stored it in notes.  Update wiped my data.  I should have known better than trust an app.

reviews.title: It WAS good…
reviews.text: This was a very solid app until the last update wiped out all the service dates. The developer is on record on Facebook blaming the users for not reading the terms and conditions of the app for the cause of our issues. Please find a better app developed by someone who has a better understanding of how to keep data integrity. This developer clearly has no idea what that concept is.

reviews.title: Update ruined it
reviews.text: I loved it for years and after the update all of the dates reset to 0001😡. Trying to find a replacement.

reviews.title: Was great app
reviews.text: I have been using this app for years . Looks like with the last update , all my info is gone . Dates are gone . How can we get all the data back ??

reviews.title: What Happened?
reviews.text: I just went into app for first time this year. All my service dates are gone. Going back to paper and pencil.

reviews.title: All dates defaulted to 1/1/1900
reviews.text: I really liked this app but the last update defaulted all my service dates that I took a lot of time to manually enter to 1/1/1900.  Super annoying, I probably spent a few hours entering dated from my paper records.

reviews.title: Not worth data loss
reviews.text: Come back to the app after an update, all my maintenance is dated 1/1/1900 and half the photos are deleted. Clearly app does not have the support needed to truly trust. Waste of time and really disappointing that now I’ll need to recreate the record of my entire maintenance over the last 2 years.

reviews.title: Lost sql light
reviews.text: Very bad software lost year worth of data on four car not worth it junk code.

reviews.title: Great app until last update
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years and it has been great! I wouldn’t think twice about giving it a 4 star rating if I hadn’t lost all the dates for my maintenance activities after the last update. What a bummer.

reviews.title: Lost all maintenance dates for all my vehicles
reviews.text: You would think that for an app that tracks vehicle maintenance, it would track vehicle maintenance dates. But no, now all dates have been erased. Super frustrating

reviews.title: Don’t recommend
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for several years to maintain 5 autos and found it very useful, but, a recent update wiped out all the documented  maintenance item dates and maintenance item mileage. I’m
going to have to reconstruct everything from scratch based on any receipts I still have. What a huge hassle and waste of my time.

reviews.title: Where’s the dates?
reviews.text: Had years of services on many cars and other items, all the dates disappeared. All of them. Is it gone forever? It can be fixed by an update. This is the 2nd app I’ve had over 10 years that has screwed me. Convenient as it is, get a manual book as these apps are unstable. I lost another record after an update for an app that was no longer supported. Couldn’t get any data from it.

reviews.title: Not much use living in 1900
reviews.text: Opened to make addition to vehicles, all dates have returned to January 1 1900.

reviews.title: Lost All Dates of records
reviews.text: Loved the app but lost all dates of service and new service record dates don’t save. Reached out to developer and haven’t heard back. Bummed to say the least.

reviews.title: Defective App
reviews.text: I was affected by the defect several months ago where all service dates were lost and unrecoverable.  After taking a chance today and spending 2 plus hours updating the dates for all my service entries, I close and reopen the app, and the dates are all missing again.  Decided to use the Car Cave app and it’s so much better and only costs 2.99 for pro features includes iCloud backup!

reviews.title: All Service Dates Defaulted to Jan 1, 0001
reviews.text: I have the bug that has infected many other users of the app. I have four vehicles in the household and been using the app for years to keep track of services done.  It was so easy, until it wasn’t.  Over 6 months ago ALL of the service dates went to Jan 1, 0001.  I’ve sent in requests to have it fixed and as of today it is not.  I know they are now promoting a paid version, but why would I think it would be any different. I lost all of the dates of services but luckily I have the mileages.

reviews.title: Was great app
reviews.text: I really like this app tracking all my vehicles maintenance, but now it says everything that was done 1/1/1900.

reviews.title: Great until it deletes everything you imputed
reviews.text: Had my 3 cars on this app and carefully tracked and imputed  everything in the past year and now everything‘s gone.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: All my dates reset to Jan 1, 0001

reviews.title: Lost all dates
reviews.text: I was really enjoying this app, worked well for about two years. Then out of no where it changed all my dates for my vehicles to 01/01/0001. Will be switching to something more reliable!

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text: At some point the dates of past services all reset to 1-1-1900. Correcting this manually is futile, as the app won’t hold the corrected date - it always resets to 1-1-1900. This was a good app - certainly one worth paying for. But I have little interest  in getting the paid “pro” version (which requires an annual subscription) after this lousy experience.

reviews.title: Lost Dates - Not Good
reviews.text: You’ll live the simplistic nature of this app and the information it stores, until it updates and makes all the maintenance entry dates Jan 1st, 1900.  It wasn’t made clear from the beginning, if there’s a “paid” version that will not do this, but I would have paid!  The consequences of not having good data, when dealing with warranty issues is huge!  Some dealerships will simply refuse warranty service, if you can’t prove regular maintenance.  With that, I’m looking elsewhere, and I recommend you DO NOT use this app.

reviews.title: Lost information
reviews.text: All my dates of service  records were lost on all 3 vehicles. All dates reset to 01/01/0001, I try to change them and soon as I exit the app they default back to 01/01/0001 again.

reviews.title: Drops Dates
reviews.text: I like how simple it is and all that. The only complaint I have is that the maintenance dates get dropped eventually.  I sometimes want to know when I did something, and I can’t look it up.

reviews.title: Horrible Update
reviews.text: This app always had annoying quirks like no ability to enlarge, or export photos entered into the service log, but the last update wiped out all of my previous logs details!  Literally years worth of entries now have no service details!  Hard fail!  I will be looking for something with more features and more reliable.

reviews.title: Great app before recent update.
reviews.text: Loved using the app for my vehicles, lawn mower and snowblower. This last update wiped out all of the service dates and defaulted back to 1-1-1900 on everything.

reviews.title: Erases dates
reviews.text: App worked great until last update which erased all of the dates.

reviews.title: Dates Messed Up
reviews.text: After last Update, service dates keep restarting to 1 January 1900

reviews.title: Service Dates Are Gone
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a few years and never had an issue until today. I was about to enter a  new service and noticed that all my previous service dates are Jan 01, 0001. Is there a fix for this issue as I no longer have confidence in using this app.

reviews.title: Wiped all service dates
reviews.text: This was great until recently when I went to add a recent oil change, I noticed all my dates and cost history were wiped.. this is 100% no good without anyway to recover. Makes this app 100% useless now.

reviews.title: Dates of past service deleted
reviews.text: All of the dates for my past services are now reading January 1 1900. Years of keeping detailed records is gone!

reviews.title: Dates erased
reviews.text: All the dates got erased from the last update

reviews.title: Was a great app
reviews.text: The latest update caused all my dates to reset. I have 4 vehicles that I track maintenance on with no dates. I’ve been using this app for years without any problems and now I’m going to have to look for a new maintenance tracker. Please fix!

reviews.title: Worked great for years, now dates gone
reviews.text: It seems that the last update changed the dates on all my maintenance to 1/1/1900.  Maybe it can be fixed and I would give 4 stars

reviews.title: Dates reset
reviews.text: For no reason all the service date were wiped out and set to Jan 1 1900?

reviews.title: Latest update changed all my service dates
reviews.text: ALL of my service dates were changed to Jan 1, 1900.  What did you all do????

reviews.title: Lost service dates
reviews.text: Looks like app was updated and put all my service dates back to 01/01/0001. Lost all my service dates.

reviews.title: Dates are gone
reviews.text: I have used this app for years. With the most recent update lost all of my service dates. Very inconvenient.

reviews.title: Recent update deletes data-view reviews ‘sorted by most recent’
reviews.text: Recent update deletes service dates. Developer responds by saying Terms and Conditions say they’re not responsible.  No apologies from the developer and expected solution can be found.

reviews.title: Was great until it wasn’t.
reviews.text: I have been using this for past 2 years and I thought this app was great. Tracked all my maintenances that I had been doing on my cars and equipment. I went to logon on to check what I used previously for oil and I noticed all my logs had their dates reset to 01/01/0001. I don’t know what happened. I didn’t switch phones or uninstall and reinstall the app. This app was great until I had this bug. I’m going to switch back to keeping a paper record.

reviews.title: Use this app if you’d like to lose your data
reviews.text: Decent tracking tool until you realize that it doesn’t save all the maintenance event data.   I track 6 different vehicles in here and even though the title of the maintenance events was saved, the app wiped out the associated dates, mileages, engine hours, etc.   it didn’t just do that for one of the maintenance events. It didn’t it for every single event for every single vehicle.

reviews.title: No bueno
reviews.text: Had the app for a long time for five vehicles. One day I open the application and all the dates have been set to 1900. I’ll switch to Autozone app to keep track of my vehicle maintenance.

reviews.title: All my service dates reset to 01-01-1900.  Losing all my service dates.
reviews.text:
App worked fairly well for what I needed but recently reset all my service dates on several vehicles I do maintenance on changing all my previous service dates on all vehicles to 01-01-1900.
Now I have no actual real records of the dates I did any maintenance.  Disappointing.

reviews.title: You will lose data
reviews.text: This app has been helpful but recently all my dates have rest to 01/01/1900. The developer has no fix and blames you for not paying for the premium version. Mileage data has been kept but I have now moved onto using Google Sheets.

reviews.title: Lost all my records
reviews.text: What started out as a great tool has ended up being an epic fail. With one of the latest updates, it seems that many users to include myself has lost all or partial records. In my case all. Rather than own it, and figure out a way to reload them from an archive, Hai, the owner chooses to hide behind his Terms or Service. Spare yourself the time. While its user friendly and the function is great, it does you know good if you’re records are gone.

reviews.title: Was great until it wasn't
reviews.text: I thought this was finally THE app for logging vehicle maintenance. Until I opened it the other day to discover that my last two years of info had all reset their dates to January 1, 0001. Not a big deal for maintenance due at certain mileage, but sure screwed my reminders set by date!!  Thanks alot!

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years. The pictures you save are impossible to review at a later date. Also the app did an update and half my info went missing on my vehicles. All dates changed to 1 Jan 1900, and notes were deleted. I was using this as a digital record of my maintenance and lost all my hard work.

reviews.title: Still, no response from the developer
reviews.text: If you scroll through the most recent comments, you will see that everyone has the same issue with this app and there’s still been no response from the developer. This leads me to believe that changing all the dates to January 1, 1900 was a ploy to get everyone to buy their pro version. Typical, make the free version unworkable and hope everybody just goes to pro. What a useless app.

reviews.title: All records reset to Jan 1, 1900
reviews.text: The last update changed all the dates to every record I had for all listed vehicles to January 1, 1900 making date dependent maintenance records useless. So disappointed, I had 5 cars with records dating as far back as 2021. It was good until date resetting all records from last update.

reviews.title: Service dates no longer in saved files
reviews.text: Had this app for several years and used it to keep records for my lifetime warranty purchased with the truck as well as to keep track of any maintenance for all other equipment. Highly disappointed that data that I had saved to my files isn’t retained in the file so there’s no way to prove when the maintenance was performed. Should not happen to saved data. Now there’s the possibility that a warranty I paid thousands. For won’t pay b/c I can’t prove that the recommended maintenance was performed on schedule as required. Now I have no idea how long it’s been since something was completed

reviews.title: Latest update wiped out date information for all records
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years, and it worked great. The latest update wiped out the date information on all my records across seven different vehicles. On the Facebook group, the developer essentially shirked responsibility. I’m going back to pen and paper. Avoid this app - you’ve been warned.

reviews.title: App Update Wiped Out My Dates!!
reviews.text: Great app UNTIL THE LAST UPDATE!! Wiped out all of my dates on the service records! Horrible update. I have spent years creating this information and updating it on a weekly basis to keep track of my multiple vehicles, and to lose all the dates is absolutely catastrophic. I set up my maintenance reminders based on dates and I do my services based on dates, I do my fuel treatments based on dates. Unless they fix this, I will have to get a different app. What an absolute nightmare. Really disappointed!

reviews.title: Good, than not
reviews.text: I love everything about this app. Simple that’s what I needed. Nothing fancy. Dates and mileage two very important factors. I open the app to enter more car maintenance and all my dates are zeroed out. Not happy at all.  This issue needs fixing asap!  I will gladly change my review if this gets addressed.

reviews.title: Switched from imperial to metric and currency without my consent
reviews.text: App was ok until it changed all my millage to Kilometers without my permission and expenses mysteriously changed from USD to British Pound. I have no idea why it did that. I cannot find any way to change it back. I don’t use Facebook so customer support doesn’t exist for me. I therefore have no choice but to remove this app from my phone and use a different app.
